verdict.rationale: Slack's huddles page says users can 'instantly connect over audio or video and share screens' inside huddles, and pitches huddles as a space to 'collaborate and co-create live'. This covers the core of the story: screen sharing during a call for live collaboration. Missing for 10: detailed help-center docs on screen-share mechanics (e.g., multi-sharer support, drawing/annotation, plan or admin controls), independent or hands-on corroboration, and any admin-specific aspect of the persona.
